lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly regular grid-like distribution of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately 10-12 vertical columns and 5-6 horizontal rows along the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity aligned with the columns of circular blobs, forming a matrix of grid-like anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper flank, defined by high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries running parallel to the long axis of the body.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs within the boundaries of the dorsal fin silhouette, exhibiting less regularity than the flank pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) characterized by slender, high-luminance silhouettes located near the pectoral fin and ventral region.
